_comment: Mutation testing answers the question coverage cannot: whether the tests would notice if the code were wrong. It runs on a schedule rather than per-edit because a full run rewrites and re-tests every statement, which is minutes of work for feedback that changes slowly.
_threshold_comment: Lower than the domain floor because most surviving mutants are in trpc.ts: the development-only delay in the timing middleware and the tRPC error formatter, which only runs while serialising an HTTP response and so cannot be reached through a caller. The procedures themselves score 94.
